purpose: Prospective paired clothing-only research edits; not trained-generator output

records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the edit target: one fictional clearly adult man generated by StyleGAN. Produce one independent square photograph, not a collage. Make a precise clothing-only edit: replace ONLY the visible shirt/jacket and lower neckline with a black Roman clerical shirt and a recognizable thin white Roman clerical collar tab just below the chin. Keep the tab naturally visible in the existing frame without moving the face or chin. Preserve exactly the same face, skin texture, wrinkles, hair, facial hair, glasses if present, expression, gaze, eye coordinates, mouth coordinates, pose, head size, body position, lighting and background. Do not remove or add background people, objects, or image area. Do not recrop, zoom, stretch, beautify, smooth skin, redraw facial features, or reposition anything. Convert the final whole photograph to natural black and white, preserving the original square composition. No hats, new jewelry, text, watermark, extra objects, or reflected padding. Prioritize unchanged facial geometry over enlarging the collar.
